03 / BUILD FOR GOOD · PROJECT 28

LESS ADMIN.
MORE CAPACITY.

The specific problem

Small NGO coordinators turn scattered field notes into recurring donor reports. We need a pilot NGO to validate the workload and required report format.

The AI step

Planned: interpret unstructured notes, group activities, preserve counts, flag missing information and draft a donor-ready report. Never invent beneficiaries, outcomes or numbers.

Human approval

A coordinator reviews and edits the draft. Sending remains blocked until the final version is approved.

Mobile app

Installable web app with a mobile workspace and offline shell. Not an App Store or Play Store release. Inputs are held in memory and may be lost when the app closes. No automatic background sending.

Development stages

1 · Available: Local notes workspace, editable draft, approval gate, text export and installable mobile app shell.

2 · Built, awaiting configuration: Server-side AI drafting, quote validation and numeric checks. Full factual accuracy still requires human review.

3 · Partial: Browser PDF export available. DOCX, n8n and donor delivery remain planned.

4 · Planned: Donation acknowledgements, duplicate protection and delivery tracking.

5 · Planned: NGO pilot, measured results and submission.

Judging & submission requirements

Problem framing 25 · AI 30 · Usefulness 20 · Execution 15 · Clarity 10, according to the handbook. The project guide gives different weights; confirm with organisers.

Use dummy data in the recording. Test with a real NGO for potential bonus points. Measure time saved; no results are claimed yet.

Prepare a problem/solution document, working demo, accessible Drive folder and form submission. Video instructions conflict: retain a three-minute pitch and confirm the final required length.
